messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. It has a broad, flat, pale pink head with a rounded snout, a wide straight mouth, small nostrils, large round dark eyes, and dark speckling on the crown and cheeks. Behind the head are six pink fleshy external gill stalks, three per side, bearing dense feathery filaments. The back from the neck to the tail is covered in neat overlapping rows of large rounded dark gray-brown scales with tan edges. The underside of the torso and tail and the four thick limbs are smooth pale pinkish-white skin with transverse wrinkles and folds. The four limbs are sturdy and splayed for walking, each ending in a broad foot with slender claw-tipped digits. A long tapering tail extends to the left, scaly on top and pale underneath, with the tip cropped by the edge of the image.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale pink rounded-snout head with wide mouth, small nostrils and smooth skin", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round black eyes with pale rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink fleshy stalks with dense feathery pink filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "three on each side protruding sideways and upward from behind the head"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded dark gray-brown plates with tan edges in neat rows", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the back from the neck to the tail and the top of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale pinkish-white smooth skin with transverse wrinkles and folds", "part": "underbelly skin", "where": "on the underside of the torso and tail and on the legs"}, {"looks_like": "four thick pale pink fleshy limbs with wrinkled skin, two under the chest and two under the rear torso", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, splayed for standing"}, {"looks_like": "broad paws with slender digits tipped with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering tail, scaly on top and smooth pale underneath", "part": "tail", "where": "extending left from the rear of the body and cropped by the image edge"}, {"looks_like": "small dark gray speckles", "part": "markings", "where": "scattered on the top and sides of the head"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
